title: 1 Science KCPE 2002
text:
KENYA NATIONAL EXAMINATIONS COUNCIL
 KCPE 2002
 SCIENCE
 READ THESE INSTRUCTIONS CAREFULLY
 Time:1 hour 40 minutes
 1. You have been given this question booklet and a separate answer sheet. The question booklet
 contains 50 question
 2. Do any necessary rough work in this booklet.
 3. When you have chosen your answer, mark it on the ANSWER SHEET, not in this question
 booklet.
 4. Use only an ordinary pencil.
 5. Make sure that you have written on the answer sheet:
 YOUR INDEX NUMBER
 YOUR NAME
 NAME OF YOUR SHOOL
 6. By drawing a dark line inside the correct numbered boxes mark your full Index Number(i.e
 School code number and the three-figured Candidate’s number)in the grid near the top of the
 answer sheet.
 7. Do not make any marks outside the boxes.
 8. Keep the sheet as clean as possible and do not fold it.
 9. For each of the question 1-50 four answers are given. The answers are lettered A,B,C and D. In
 each case only ONE of the four answers is correct. Choose the correct answer.
 10. On the answer sheet the correct answer is to be shown by drawing a dark line inside the box in
 which the letter have chosen is written.
 Example
 In the Question booklet.
 4. Which one of the following components of blood is involved in the clotting after injury?
 A. Plasma
 B. White blood cells
 C. Red blood cells
 D. Platelets
 The correct answer is D
 1 [A] [B] [C] [D] 14. [A] [B] [C] [D] 24. [A] [B] [C] [D] 34. [A] [B] [C] [D]
 11. Your dark line MUST be within the box.
 12. For each question ONLY ONE box is to be marked in each set of four boxes.
 This question paper consists of 7 printed pages and 1 black page.
 The Kenya National Examination Council, 2002.
 1. Which one of the following bodies produces light
 A. Mars
 B. Venus
 C. Star
 D. Moon
 2. Which one of the following explains why flowering water moves objects
 A. Has energy of movement
 B. Is a liquid
 C. Has potential energy
 D. Carries less denser objects only
 3. Which one of the following insects undergoes the stages of egg, Nymph and adult in its cycle?
 A. Tsetse fly
 B. Wasp
 C. Butterfly
 D. Cockroach
 4. The diagram below represents parts of flower
 The function of part labeled P is to
 A. Produce nectar
 B. Receives pollen grains
 C. Lead pollen grain to ovary
 D. Produce pollen grain
 5. Engine oil mixes with kerosene but does not mix with water. Metylated spirit mixes with water
 but does not mix with kerosene. How many layers would be observed if the four liquids would
 be observed if the four liquids were put in the same container?
 A. 1
 B. 2
 C. 3
 D. 4
 6. A chameleon shoots its tongue to
 A. Taste food
 B. Locate food
 C. Catch food
 D. Cool itself
 7. The chart below represents a simple classification of plants
 Which plant is represented by P and Q
 P Q
 A. Ferns moss
 B. Banana ferns
 C. Moss mushroom
 D. Grass banana
 8. The diagram below represents parts of a germinating seed
 The part labeled K
 A. Serves as first leaves
 B. A becomes a shoot
 C. Absorbs water for the young plant
 D. Gives rise to root
 9. On the cold day birds raises their feathers to
 A. Allow air to escape from their bodies
 B. Allow even distribution of heat in the body
 C. Avoid losing heat from their bodies
 D. Generate heat
 10. The diagram below represents an instruments that could be used to demonstrate that solid
 expand when heated
 Which one of the following should be done to make the instrument more efficient?
 A. Using a thinner pointer
 B. Reduce the length between support Q and pivot
 C. Using thicker wire
 D. Increase the length between P and pivot
 11. Pupil placed little methylated spirit in a tin can and lit it. After a short while, they placed the tin
 can upside down over soft placed mud as shown in the diagram below.
 The tin can sank into the soft mud. Which of the following explains why the tin can sank into the
 mud?
 A. The tin can is denser than soft mud
 B. Air pressure on the tin can forced the tin can into the soft mud?
 C. There was no air in the soft mud
 D. Forced of gravity forced the tin can into the soft mud
 12. Objects P, Q, R and S were balanced on a beam as shown in the diagram below
 The correct order from the heaviest to the lightest objects is
 A. S Q R P
 B. Q R P S
 C. R S Q P
 D. Q P S R
 13. The diagram below represents a weather record that was made by pupils for 5 days
 Which one of the following statements about the weather is correct? Whenever it
 A. Was windy, there was rain
 B. Was sunny, it was windy
 C. Rained, it was windy
 D. Was windy in the morning, it rained in the afternoon
 14. Which one of diagram below represents the correct set up that is used to compare drainage of
 water in different types of soil
 15. Which of the following drugs is a stimulant when used in small quantities but a depressant
 when in large quantities?
 A. Tobacco
 B. Coffee
 C. Khat
 D. Alcohol
 16. A stick was placed behind a bottle half filled with water as shown in the diagram below
 The part of the stick below the level of water appeared to be larger in size than the part above
 the level of water because rays of light were
 A. Absorbed
 B. Refracted
 C. Dispersal
 D. Reflected
 17. Which one of the ways of producing light involves energy changes from chemical to electrical
 and lastly to heat and light? Using a
 A. Bicycle
 B. Hydroelectric generator
 C. Solar cells
 D. Torch
 18. The diagram below represents a mammalian heart name it correctly
 19. Fruits which are dispersed by water
 A. Have pods with lines of weakness
 B. Are small and hairly
 C. Are hollow and fibrous
 D. Are small with hooks
 20. A certain animal lay eggs, has scale and the body temperature varies with the surrounding. The
 animals is likely to be a
 A. Snakes
 B. Platypus
 C. Toad
 D. Duck
 21. The type of modified root found in mangroves are called
 A. Breathing
 B. Prop
 C. Buttress
 D. Clasping
 22. Which one the following is the function of rectum?
 A. Completes digestion of food
 B. Stores undigested matter
 C. Absorbs water
 D. Absorbs digested food
 23. Which one of the following aspects of a given objects DOES NOT affect sinking of floating of the
 objects?
 A. Size
 B. Material
 C. Shape
 D. Weight
 24. A purple flower extract was added to substances KLM and N to find out whether they were acid
 or bases. The results are shown in the table below. Which of the two substances react to form
 salt water only?
 A. K and M
 B. M and n
 C. K and L
 D. L and M
 25. Which one the following aspects of an objects cannot be changed?
 A. Mass
 B. Density
 C. Weight
 D. Volume
 26. Which one of following should not be the same when comparing rates of melting in the
 substances
 A. Quantity of substance
 B. Amount of heat
 C. The substances
 D. Duration of heat
 27. Standard eight pupils suggested the following as a way of preventing monkeys from destroying
 crops
 i) Laying traps for the monkey
 ii) Putting up a fence around the farm
 iii) Seeking assistance of the game warden
 iv) Guarding the farm
 Which one of the following is not acceptable?
 A. (i)
 B. (ii)
 C. (iii)
 D. (iv)
 28. The diagram below represent lever being used used to open a tin
 Which one the following works in the same way as the lever shown above
 A. Carrying a load using a wheelbarrow
 B. Cutting hair using using a scissors
 C. Scooping fish using a rod
 D. Catching used
 29. Which one the following statement about a single fixed pulley is not correct? The load
 A. Distance is equal to the effort distance
 B. Moves in the opposite direction to that of the effort
 C. Is twice the effort used
 D. Is equal to the effort used
 30. The planet with a ring around it is called
 A. Mercury
 B. Saturn
 C. Pluto
 D. Jupiter
 31. The soil that drains water fastest
 A. Has small air space
 B. Cracks when dry
 C. Has poor capillarity
 D. Has smooth texture
 32. The diagram below represents an improvised instrument that could be used to measure room
 temperature
 The working of the instrument is based on the fact that
 A. Liquids expands when heated and contract when cooled
 B. Liquids rise in narrow tube
 C. Gases exerts pressure
 D. Gases expand when heated and contract when cooled
 33. The component of air in the atmosphere whose amount varies from time is
 A. Oxygen
 B. Water vapour
 C. Carbon dioxide
 D. Nitrogen
 34. The stage involved in the formation of rain are
 I) Clouds are formed
 II) Water evaporates
 III) Heat from the sun warms water
 IV) Rain falls
 V) Water vapour condense
 The correct order in which the stage takes place is
 A. (iii) (ii) (i) (v) (iv)
 B. (ii) (iii) (v) (iv)(i)
 C. (ii) (v) (iii) (iv)
 D. (iii) (ii) (v) (i) (iv)
 35. The diagram below represents an arrangement of bottle tops to show the working of gears
 In which direction will F G and H turn when E is turned in a clockwise direction?
 36. The diagram below represents a simple machines that is used to draw water from a river
 The effort distance is
 A. XY
 B. WX
 C. YW
 D. YZ
 37. The following activities involved in making an improvised hammer
 i) Making a hole
 ii) Fitting a bolt
 iii) Shaping a piece of wood
 iv) Making the handle smooth
 v) Fixing the nut
 The correct order is
 A. (iii) (iv) (i) (ii) (v)
 B. (i) (ii) (v) (iii) (iv)
 C. (iii) (i) (ii) (v) (iv)
 D. (v) (ii) (iii) (iv) (i)
 38. Which one of the following groups of drugs are harmful but legal in Kenya
 A. Tobacco, khat, beer
 B. Heroin, bhang, beer
 C. Bhang, heroin, mandrax
 D. Tobacco, mandax, khat
 39. Vaccine are
 A. Stimulus
 B. Preventive drugs
 C. Curative drug
 D. Pain relievers
 40. The planet that takes the longest time to move round the sun once is called
 A. Uranus
 B. Venus
 C. Mars
 D. Saturn
 41. One of the following practices does not help conservation water. Which one is it
 A. Drip irrigation
 B. Using oil to kill mosquito larva
 C. Treating water from a factory
 D. Mulching
 42. Birds which feed on grains have beaks that are
 A. Strong, short and curved
 B. Strong, short and cupped
 C. Long, sharp and straight
 D. Strong, short and straight
 43. Which one of the following sets of characteristic are description of wind pollinated flower
 A. Fewer large pollen grains, petals sometimes absents
 B. Fewer large pollen grains, large loosely attached anthers
 C. Small in size, large loosely attached anthers stickly stigma
 D. Small in size, large loosely attached anther petals sometimes absent
 44. The diagram below represents a periscope and the position of the image at point U
 The object is at point
 A. S
 B. T
 C. U
 D. V
 45. If the hole of the pinhole camera is widened the image
 A. Becomes blurred
 B. Becomes larger
 C. Is upright
 D. Is not formed on the screen
 46. Which one of the following pairs consists substances that have definite volume?
 A. Water vapour and ice
 B. Sand and water
 C. Stone and air
 D. Ice and air
 47. A suitable way of handling plastic materials to avoid pollution is
 A. Dumping in the river
 B. Burning
 C. Burying in the soil
 D. Re-using
 48. The diagram below represents a simple machine
 The machine is an example of
 A. Gear
 B. Lever
 C. Inclined plane
 D. Wheel and axle
 49. A group of people filled a transparent bottle with soil and water. They shook the bottle and left
 to stand for sometimes. The layer formed as shown in the diagram below
 The layer that is composed of water making
 A. 1
 B. 2
 C. 3
 D. 4

 A. Insulators
 B. Handles of cooking
 C. Fuses
